title: Finite coproduct decomposition of a smooth relative-dimension-one curve
statement: Let k be a field and f:C -> Spec k a quasi-compact separated smooth morphism of relative dimension one [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. There exist a finite index type I, schemes D_i, morphisms g_i:D_i -> Spec k and coprojections iota_i:D_i -> C, such that each g_i is a connected smooth curve [def-sc-curves], iota_i followed by f equals g_i, and C with these coprojections is a coproduct of the D_i [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. The index type is allowed to be empty, so this includes C empty. No algebraic closure or field extension is required.

source.place: First step: finite clopen component reduction; Finite coproduct decomposition of a smooth relative-dimension-one curve

proof.text: SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth gives smoothness. Apply Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace; hence C is Noetherian. The proved upstream NoetherianSpace.locallyConnectedSpace supplies locally connectedness, and Mathlib gives a finite discrete type ConnectedComponents C. Its singleton preimages are clopen open subschemes U c.

Set D c=(U c).toScheme, iota c=(U c).iota and g c=iota c followed by f. Mathlib gives separatedness, finite type and quasi-compactness, and smoothOfRelativeDimension_comp gives relative dimension one. connectedComponents_preimage_singleton and isConnected_connectedComponent give ConnectedSpace (U c). Apply the already proved upstream topologicalKrullDim_le_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension and topologicalKrullDim_eq_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension to g c. Their conclusions fill the IsConnectedCurve fields, without any unproved geometry lemma.

Singleton preimages are pairwise disjoint and cover C. Mathlib nonempty_isColimit_cofanMk_of applied to the open immersions gives exactly the required coproduct universal property. If C is empty, the same proof uses the empty component type.

from.place: Reduction to connected curves by the finite clopen decomposition, before the connected-curve estimate

lean.statement:
theorem exists_smoothCurveConnectedCoproduct
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsSeparated f] [QuasiCompact f] :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Finite I) (D : I → Scheme.{u})
      (g : ∀ i, D i ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (ι : ∀ i, D i ⟶ C),
      (∀ i, IsConnectedCurve (g i) ∧ Smooth (g i)) ∧
      (∀ i, ι i ≫ f = g i) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk C ι))
